abort.dahua_not_installed: The ha-dahua integration is not installed. Install it from HACS first, then run this setup again.

error.address_required: Please enter the camera IP address.
error.auth_failed: The camera rejected the login. Check that the security code from the QR code is correct.
error.dahua_already_configured: This camera is already set up in ha-dahua.
error.device_unreachable: Nothing responded at that address. Check the IP and that the camera is powered and on the same network.
error.drive_failed: Adding the camera through ha-dahua failed. Try adding it from the ha-dahua integration directly, then run this setup to manage it.
error.drive_timeout: ha-dahua took too long to discover the camera. Check the camera is reachable, then try again.
error.no_devices_found: No Dahua-like camera was found on the local network. Enter the camera's IP address manually.
error.qr_missing_sc: No security code (SC) was found in that text. Paste the full QR code text from the manual.
error.qr_unrecognized: That text is not a QR payload and not a plain security code.
error.serial_missing: The camera answered but did not return a serial number.
error.sn_mismatch: The serial number in that QR code does not match this camera. Check you scanned the right camera's manual.

confirm.description:
Ready to add the camera at {address}.

What happens next: the integration signs in to the camera and checks that its serial number matches your QR code, creates the ha-dahua entry for you, and takes a test snapshot to confirm the camera really works. From then on, the IP guardian checks the address every hour and repairs it automatically if the camera's IP changes.
confirm.title: Add camera

manual.description:
This companion adds a LIXIL camera to Home Assistant through the ha-dahua integration, then keeps an eye on its IP address.

Enter the camera's IP address on your local network. You can find it in your router's list of connected devices — the camera's MAC address starts with 1C:4D:89 on the verified model. After you enter it, the camera is probed to check that it answers like a Dahua-based device.
manual.title: Enter the camera IP

qr.description:
Scan the QR code printed in the camera's manual (or on its label) with your phone, then paste the decoded text here. It contains the device serial number (SN) and the security code (SC), which is the camera's password.

The security code is extracted automatically and handed straight to ha-dahua — this companion never stores it. Pasting only the security code also works.
qr.title: Paste the QR code text

user.description:
Your local network was scanned automatically, and the cameras below answered like Dahua-based devices. Pick yours to continue.

If your camera is not listed — for example it sits on a different subnet — choose manual entry instead.
user.title: Choose your camera
